---
title: Failed with no money movement
source: internal
document_type: policy
version: v1
effective_from: 2026-08-01
---

A failed, cancelled, or rejected payment or payout with no settlement and no bank movement is MATCHED. Nothing moved, so there is no unexplained cash.

Failed plus an unexplained bank CREDIT or DEBIT is UNRESOLVED. Exposure is the structured variance amount. That is unresolved exposure, not proven permanent loss.
